answer_1.quote: We evaluate IE and baselines in two Python code generation tasks: HumanEval  and MBPP .

answer_2.quote: We assess code generation using Pass@k, and detectability using AUROC, which measures the model's ability to distinguish watermarked from non-watermarked text. We also report the True Positive Rate (TPR)... We propose the Unified Effectiveness Score (UES), averaging the normalized Pass@1 and detectability metrics...
